verdict.rationale: FutureHouse/Edison is a hosted SaaS platform whose research agents are reached through a Python client and API, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only the edison-client SDK, API-key authentication, task submission and chat sessions; nothing mentions an MCP server or endpoint. An SDK and an llms.txt docs index are developer building blocks or adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
